name: Feature Color Switcher
description: Four feature cards beside one tall panel that color-shifts through brand-tinted states and crossfades mockups. Drive is scroll-spy on desktop (active card = nearest viewport center) plus hover and click; the active card tints and the panel fill tweens to a matching brand shade.
interactions: desktop scroll-spy (verbatim): on scroll/resize, active card = the one whose vertical center is nearest innerHeight/2 (gated to innerWidth >= 901)
hover (mouseenter, desktop) and click also set the active card
active card background tints to its brand shade (.4s); panel fill tweens between four brand tints via data-active (.5s); matching panel layer crossfades opacity (.5s)
below 900px the grid stacks to one column and the panel moves above the cards (order -1)
